title: 01/24/20 - Software Updates
content:
## 01/24/20 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000066655

We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the Properties Search Module from displaying the "Property Type" search field in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Module - Property Search Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Property Search

- We updated the Design Settings area of the Admin to only show the "Member Search Results Layout", "Post Search Results Layout" and "Favorites" settings when the relevant Add-Ons are activated for a site.

- We updated the design of the "View Posts" page for each post type in the Member Dashboard. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Body datatable Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums datatable

- We updated the Search Members page in the Admin to speed up the page load time.

- We updated the "Parent Account" information on the Search Members page in the Admin to be a link to make information about the "Parent Account" of a member more accessible.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Rotate Image" functionality for multi-image post types from working correctly on Apple devices.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the Breadcrumb links on Review details pages to return a 404 error in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Display Breadcrumbs

- We updated the Form Manager in the Admin so a user who creates a new form is redirected immediately to edit the  newly created form.

- We updated the Properties Search Module and the fields in the Get Matched form to make them more uniformly controlled by the Form Manager. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Module - Property Search Bootstrap Theme - Form - Lead Prefer Reply Day Bootstrap Theme - Form - Lead Prefer Reply Time

- We fixed an issue with the Google Maps Location field when editing a post that was preventing the selected location from automatically populating the "Location" field for the post. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Form - Member Google Location

- We fixed an issue with the Form Manager which was allowing a custom copy of a Default Form to be created without any changes being made to the form.

- We updated the Member Images page in the Admin in order to speed up the page load time.

- We added the ability to export Form Inquiries records in the Admin This feature is available for all sites that have the Export Member Data Add-On active. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Emails >> Form Inquiries page.

- We updated the Category fields on the Search Members page in the Admin in order to keep the selected values after performing a search.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from saving the "Menu CSS Class" field when creating a new Menu in the Admin in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the Sub-Sub Category Dynamic Filter widget to not work as expected in some cases.

- The "Listing - Write a Review" form is now fully compatible with Text Labels.

- We removed the "Sales History" link from the Digital Products section in the Member Dashboard Area. The Sales History is now a tab when viewing or creating a new Digital Product. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Header Bootstrap Theme - Account - Manage Digital Products

- We updated the post links in the Member Account Sidebar in order to not toggle expand an accordion with additional options when clicked, but instead redirects the user directly to view their posts of that type when clicked. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Sidebar

- We fixed an issue which was causing the Member Photo Upload module in the Member Dashboard to stretch images uploaded as the Profile Cover Photo in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Profile Image Upload

- We moved the Profile Statistics menu option from the "Manage Listing" section of the Sidebar Menu in the Member Dashboard to be its own menu item. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Sidebar

- We updated the layout when publishing the first post of a give type in the Member Dashboard.  Now a new note will display when adding the first post. New text label: publish_your_first. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Header

- We implemented a security update in order to prevent SQL injections on search results pages. Widgets Involved: Search - Group - Search Query Search - Member - Search Query Search - Post - Search Query Search - Reviews - Search Query

- We updated the HTACCESS File editor in the Admin.
